purpose: Finish retained original data after the original confirmation deadline failed; never relabel that failed campaign
operations: Verify exact fixed prefix against the preserved pre-restart SHA256 manifest
Export every split from the retained committed preparation transaction, with no resampling or changed labels
Independently replay all original games and reconstruct the complete deduplication, split, feature, target and contributor records
Record separate finalization and verification receipts while preserving all earlier failed receipts
restart_rule: Original acquisition stays stopped. A separately authorized finalization deadline is fixed once and never reset by process replacement. A new failure remains failed.
authorization_scope: One separately authorized six-hour fixed-prefix finalization and independent replay. The prior failed acquisition is unchanged.
source_policy: Archive committed code and holdouts before running export/replay. Later working-tree changes cannot alter stages.
exclusions: No new generation, model training, model selection, opponent match or release runs inside this finalization budget. Those retain their separate experiment contracts.
